relationships.subject: Thymus quinquecostatus polyphenol-rich fraction
relationships.evidence_quote: RT-qPCR and Western Blot results suggested that PRF regulated oxidative stress (OS) via activating the Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1 signaling pathway.

relationships.subject: Thymus quinquecostatus polyphenol-rich fraction
relationships.evidence_quote: PRF could directly scavenge excessive ROS in zebrafish embryos after a short-time PRF incubation

key_findings: PRF from T. quinquecostatus ameliorated tMCAO injury in rats via Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1 activation.
PRF also directly scavenged ROS in zebrafish embryos.
